# Introduction

#### Course: Learn C++ STL

## Introduction

In C++, set is a container that contains a sorted set of unique objects. In other words, a set is

1. Sorted

2. Contains unique element

From the above image, we can see that the animal set contains the keys Dog, Elephant, Goat, and Tiger (arranged alphabetically in ascending order).
